title: A reusable ratings part
prompt: I want a reusable part that any of my apps can add to let one person rate another after something they did together (a ride, an order, a job). A rating is 1 to 5 stars with an optional short comment. The person who gives it and the person who gets it are the only ones who may read it; only the person who gives it may change it. I also want a way to list all the ratings one person has received.
